description: A driving and route-learning simulator built from real places.
headline:
Driving is built.
Qualification is open.
summary: The generation foundation is delivered. Driving and its repeatable desktop benchmark are independently reviewed.

integration.title: Integration is a separate step
integration.note: Reviewed driving work remains on its branch. Canonical main holds the generation foundation.

next.label: Active task
next.title: Finish desktop qualification
next.note: Phase 04 is assigned to Astra · XHigh. Stage 04 planning can proceed; implementation follows acceptance.

stages.title: Project setup
stages.summary: An application shell with a working 3D viewport and clear module boundaries.
stages.outcome: A stable starting point for the simulator.

stages.title: Zone compiler
stages.summary: One immutable OpenStreetMap snapshot becomes deterministic roads, buildings and a street graph.
stages.outcome: Validated geometry, provenance and reproducible artifacts.

stages.title: Zone generation
stages.summary: Coordinate-based generation qualified across five real cells, extended with place search and local on-demand builds.
stages.outcome: Choose a place, build its zone, recover from errors and reuse the verified result.

stages.title: Driveability
stages.summary: Drive, collide, inspect and recover inside one flat generated cell. The implementation and benchmark are reviewed.
stages.outcome: Reliable desktop driving, supported by explicit qualification evidence.

phases.title: Physical world
phases.detail: Ground, building collision, clearance and a marked play boundary.

phases.title: First vehicle
phases.detail: Safe spawn, real physics, steering, braking, reverse and recovery.

phases.title: Driving interaction
phases.detail: Keyboard/touch controls, chase camera, pause and inspection ownership.

phases.title: Qualification
phases.detail: Broader sustained, lifecycle, desktop-browser and memory evidence is still required.

phases.title: Desktop benchmark
phases.detail: A fixed Chicago control tape, deterministic checkpoints and bounded Chrome trace capture.

stages.title: Selection & continuity
stages.summary: Define richer map selection and cache behavior, then how adjacent cells connect during driving.
stages.outcome: Move between selected areas with understandable loading and continuity.

stages.title: Geographic fidelity
stages.summary: Add the slopes, crossings and geographic details that materially improve recognition and orientation.
stages.outcome: Places become recognizable enough to support spatial memory.

stages.title: Training experience
stages.summary: Build a complete route-learning session with progressive aids, recovery from mistakes and a useful review.
stages.outcome: Practice a route, understand difficult decisions and repeat with fewer aids.

gates.title: Sustained driving
gates.detail: Valid foreground evidence across the historical five-cell qualification cases remains open.

gates.title: Chromium lifecycle
gates.detail: The earlier displayed-browser pauses and scheduling interruptions remain unresolved. One smooth Chicago benchmark does not explain them.

gates.title: Desktop coverage
gates.detail: Agree the supported browser/OS matrix. The existing desktop Safari gate is still open.

gates.title: Memory evidence
gates.detail: Complete the memory evidence or agree its measurement method. Stable resource counts alone do not establish a memory plateau.

decisions.title: Desktop first
decisions.detail: The application stays web-only. Existing touch behavior remains; desktop priority does not mean Chromium-only support.

decisions.title: GC work is parked
decisions.detail: Investigate allocation pressure and garbage collection later, with comparable evidence before choosing pooling or storage reuse. No new profiling campaign is active.

decisions.title: Plan the next boundary
decisions.detail: Next-phase discussion does not close Driveability's acceptance gates or authorize implementation.

decisions.title: Keep the foundation intact
decisions.detail: Preserve schema-v1, provenance, bounded acquisition and the compiler/runtime separation. Hosted generation remains a separate decision.

decisions.title: Keep phases lean
decisions.detail: The roadmap is living. Discuss implementation at the next phase boundary; promote necessary backbone work explicitly and remove duplicated scope.

milestones.title: A reproducible world
milestones.text: Immutable OSM, roads, buildings and a street graph.

milestones.title: Build somewhere new
milestones.text: Place search, local generation and connection recovery.

milestones.title: A vehicle to drive
milestones.text: Real physics, collision, chase view and recovery.

milestones.title: A repeatable benchmark
milestones.text: Chicago control tape and a verified desktop trace.

evidence.title: Roadmap & current direction
evidence.note: Source of stage ordering, desktop priority and deferred GC work.

evidence.title: Driveability acceptance
evidence.note: Historical passes, failures, indeterminate results and open gates.

evidence.title: Desktop benchmark review
evidence.note: One displayed Chrome/NVIDIA observation; corrected parser and immutable evidence.

handoffs.title: GC investigation deferred
handoffs.detail: Tracked in issue #1 alongside next-phase planning.

handoffs.title: Benchmark reviewed
handoffs.detail: Saved trace validated; final-span rounding bounded to 1 µs.

handoffs.title: Driveability handed back
handoffs.detail: Implementation reviewed; full stage acceptance remains open.
